pattern: A うが B うが
meaning: Expresses the idea of 'no matter how...or', 'even if...or'.
formation: Verb-volitional form + うが + Verb-volition form + うが
ja: 朝早く起きるうが、夜遅く起きるうが、いつもバスが遅れる。
romaji: Asa hayaku okiru u ga, yoru osoku okiru u ga, itsumo basu ga okureru.
en: No matter whether I wake up early in the morning or late at night, the bus is always late.

pattern: A うと B うと
meaning: To show both conditions A and B are equivalent or indifferent; 'whether A or B'.
formation: い-adjective + うと, な-adjective + であろうと, Noun + であろうと
ja: 雨が降ろうと晴れようと、私は毎日ジョギングをします。
romaji: Ame ga furo u to hare yo u to, watashi wa mainichi jogingu wo shimasu.
en: Whether it's raining or sunny, I jog every day.

meaning: Expresses 'while also'; 'at the same time as'.
formation: Verb-dictionary form + かたわら, Noun + のかたわら
ja: 彼は仕事をするかたわら、大学に通っている。
romaji: Kare wa shigoto o suru katawara, daigaku ni kayotte iru.
en: While also working, he is attending university.

pattern: A かれ B かれ
meaning: Express either A or B or both; 'whether A or B'
formation: Noun + かれ + Noun + かれ
ja: 冬かれ夏かれ、毎日ジョギングする。
romaji: Fuyu kare natsu kare, mainichi jyogingu suru.
en: Whether it is winter or summer, I jog every day.

pattern: A だの B だの
meaning: Used to list examples; 'things like', 'and so on'.
formation: Noun + だの Noun + だの
ja: 彼はいつも遅刻だの、仕事を忘れるだので困る。
romaji: Kare wa itsumo chikoku dano, shigoto wo wasureru dano de komaru.
en: I'm troubled by him always being late, forgetting work, and so on.

pattern: A であれ B であれ
meaning: Used to indicate that something applies to multiple situations; 'whether A or B'.
formation: Noun A + であれ + Noun B + であれ
ja: 雨であれ雪であれ、試合は中止にならない。
romaji: Ame deare yuki deare, shiai wa chuushi ni naranai.
en: Whether it's rain or snow, the match will not be cancelled.

pattern: A というか B というか
meaning: This phrase translates to 'rather than say A, it's more like B' or 'whether to call it A or B'.
formation: Phrase A + というか, + Phrase B + というか
ja: 彼は無礼というか、直接的というか、とにかく彼の言葉はすごくはっきりとしてます。
romaji: Kare wa burei to iu ka, chokusetsuteki to iu ka, tonikaku kare no kotoba wa sugoku hakkiri to shiteimasu.
en: He is, rather than rude, more like direct; anyway, his words are very clear.

pattern: A とも B とも
meaning: Express two possibilities; 'either A or B', 'whether A or B'.
formation: Noun + とも + Noun + とも
ja: 決断とも誤りとも、結果は時間が教えてくれるでしょう。
romaji: Ketsudan tomo ayamari tomo, kekka wa jikan ga oshiete kureru deshou.
en: Whether it's a decision or a mistake, time will tell the result.

pattern: A にしろ B にしろ
meaning: Whether it is A or B; Regardless of A or B
formation: Noun A + にしろ + Noun B + にしろ, Verb-casual A + にしろ + Verb-casual B + にしろ
ja: 暑いにしろ、寒いにしろ、毎日運動するべきです。
romaji: Atsui ni shiro, samui ni shiro, mainichi undou suru beki desu.
en: Whether it's hot or cold, you should exercise every day.

pattern: A にせよ B にせよ
meaning: Either A or B, Regardless of A or B.
formation: Noun + にせよ Noun + にせよ
ja: 雨にせよ雪にせよ、試合は中止しない。
romaji: Ame ni seyo yuki ni seyo, shiai wa chuushi shinai.
en: Whether it's rain or snow, the match won't be cancelled.

pattern: A につけ B につけ （A ni tsuke B ni tsuke）
meaning: Used to express 'whether... or...', 'both... and...', 'in either case'.
formation: Phrase A + につけ、Phrase B + につけ
ja: 彼には笑うにつけ泣くにつけ、とても魅力的な人だ。
romaji: Kare ni wa warau ni tsuke naku ni tsuke, totemo miryokuteki na hito da.
en: He is very attractive whether he is laughing or crying.

pattern: A のやら B のやら
meaning: Used when the speaker is confused or unsure about multiple things.
formation: Noun 1 + のやら + Noun 2 + のやら
ja: 彼が怒っているのやら、悲しいのやら、私には分からない。
romaji: Kare ga okotte iru no yara, kanashii no yara, watashi ni wa wakaranai.
en: I don't know whether he is angry or sad.

pattern: Noun1 が Noun1 なら、 Noun2 も Noun2 だ
meaning: Indicates 'if Noun1 is the case then it is only natural that Noun2 is the case as well.'
formation: Noun1 + が + Repeat Noun1 + なら、 + Noun2 + も + Repeat Noun2 + だ
ja: 鬼が鬼なら、人間も人間だ。
romaji: Oni ga oni nara, ningen mo ningen da.
en: If demons are demons, humans are also humans.

pattern: Noun1 も Noun1 なら、Noun2 も Noun2 だ
meaning: The structure expresses 'if it is said that ~, then it can be said that ~' or '~ not only, but also ~'.
formation: Noun1 + も + Noun1 + なら、Noun2 + も + Noun2 + だ
ja: 君も君なら、私も私だ。
romaji: Kimi mo kimi nara, watashi mo watashi da.
en: If you are you, then I am also me.

meaning: Expresses the idea 'nothing without'; something being indispensable for the existence of something else.
formation: Noun1 + あっての + Noun2
ja: 家族あっての私です。
romaji: Kazoku atte no watashi desu.
en: I am nothing without my family.

meaning: Used when doing one thing while also doing another; 'while', 'and at the same time'.
formation: Noun + かたがた
ja: 東京へ出張のかたがた、友人に会いに行った。
romaji: Toukyou e shuccho no kata gata, yujin ni ai ni itta.
en: While I was on a business trip to Tokyo, I went to see a friend.

meaning: At the same time; on the occasion of; while; along with.
formation: Noun + がてら
ja: 散歩がてらに、近くの公園で花を摘みました。
romaji: Sanpo gatera ni, chikaku no kouen de hana wo tsumimashita.
en: While taking a walk, I picked flowers in the nearby park.

meaning: Expresses 'beginning from', 'from' or 'after'. Often used to indicate a high number or large scale.
formation: Number + Counter + からある
ja: 彼のコレクションは500個からある。
romaji: Kare no korekushon wa gohyaku ko kara aru.
en: His collection starts from 500 items.

meaning: Used to indicate that something is judged, estimated, or considered from a certain point or aspect.
formation: Noun + からする
ja: 彼の態度からすると、彼はその計画に反対しているようだ。
romaji: Kare no taido kara suru to, kare wa sono keikaku ni hantai shiteiru you da.
en: Judging from his attitude, he seems to be against the plan.

meaning: Defines the starting point or the origin; 'from'.
formation: Noun + からの
ja: 日本からの手紙を受け取りました。
romaji: Nihon kara no tegami wo uketorimashita.
en: I received a letter from Japan.

meaning: Express the perspective of noun; 'from ~ point of view'
formation: Noun + から言わせれば
ja: 先生から言わせれば、毎日勉強するべきだ。
romaji: Sensei kara iwasereba, mainichi benkyou suru beki da.
en: From the teacher's point of view, you should study every day.

meaning: This term is used to describe 'entirely', 'altogether', 'as a whole' or 'collectively'.
formation: Noun + ぐるみ
ja: 家族ぐるみで旅行に行きました。
romaji: Kazoku gurumi de ryokou ni ikimashita.
en: We went on a trip as a whole family.

meaning: Expresses the meaning 'even if'; 'no matter'.
formation: Noun + こそあれ
ja: 結果こそあれ、努力したことには変わりない。
romaji: Kekka koso are, doryoku shita koto ni wa kawari nai.
en: Even if the result is what it is, the fact that we made an effort won't change.

meaning: Used to emphasize that it is precisely because of something, that another statement is true.
formation: Noun + こそ + Sentence + が
ja: 初めてこそたいせつだが、諦めないことが一番大切だ。
romaji: Hajimete koso taisetsu da ga, akiramenai koto ga ichiban taisetsu da.
en: The first step is important, of course, but what's most crucial is that you don't give up.

meaning: An emphatic expression for 'if anything', 'especially', and 'it is', which shows that other alternatives are hardly conceivable.
formation: Noun + こそすれ
ja: 仕事こそすれ何もしていない。
romaji: Shigoto kososure nani mo shite inai.
en: I am not doing anything if not working.

pattern: Noun ごとき / Noun ごとく
meaning: 'Like a...', 'like...', or 'as if'. Expresses similarity or metaphor.
formation: Noun + ごとき, Noun + ごとく, Verb-casual + ごとく, い-Adjective + ごとく
ja: 彼は天使のごとく純粋だ。
romaji: Kare wa tenshi no gotoku junsui da.
en: He is pure like an angel.

meaning: Expressing that something 'is not'; 'is not the case'.
formation: Noun or Na-Adjective + じゃあるまいし
ja: 彼は子供じゃあるまいし、その問題をしっかりと解決するべきだ。
romaji: Kare wa kodomo ja aru mai shi, sono mondai o shikkari to kaiketsu suru beki da.
en: He's not a child, he should solve that problem properly.

meaning: Denotes 'entirely' or 'nothing but'.
formation: Noun + ずくめ
ja: 彼は最近、失敗ずくめだ。
romaji: Kare wa saikin, shippai zukume da.
en: He has been nothing but failures recently.

pattern: Noun だけではすまない
meaning: Expresses 'not finish/end with just', 'cannot be settled only by'.
formation: Noun + だけではすまない
ja: この問題は謝罪だけではすまない。
romaji: Kono mondai wa shazai dake dewa sumanai.
en: This problem cannot be settled with just an apology.

meaning: This expression shows the meaning of 'not even', 'not a single'.
formation: Noun + たりとも + Negative Verb
ja: 一分たりとも無駄にするな。
romaji: Ippun tari tomo muda ni suruna.
en: Don't waste even a single minute.

meaning: Expresses the idea of 'being in the condition or state of'
formation: Noun1 + たる + Noun2
ja: リーダータル者は、常に前を見て、他の人々を導くべきだ。
romaji: Riidaa taru mono wa, tsune ni mae o mite, hoka no hitobito o michibiku beki da.
en: A person who is a leader should always look ahead and guide others.

meaning: Express 'even', 'even if', or 'as much as'.
formation: Noun + ですら
ja: 明日試験があるのに、彼はテキストブックを読むですらしない。
romaji: Ashita shiken ga aru noni, kare wa tekisutobukku o yomu desura shinai.
en: Even though we have a test tomorrow, he doesn't even read the textbook.

pattern: Noun でなくてなんだろう
meaning: Expresses the speaker's strong belief that something is certainly the case.
formation: Noun + でなくてなんだろう
ja: これが真実でなくてなんだろう。
romaji: Kore ga shinjitsu de nakute nandarou.
en: If this isn't the truth, then what is?

meaning: Use this phrase to mean 'it's not as if', 'it's not that'.
formation: Noun + ではあるまいし
ja: 彼女は、プロの歌手ではあるまいし、完璧を求めるな。
romaji: Kanojo wa, puro no kashu de wa arumai shi, kanpeki o motomeru na.
en: She is not a professional singer, so don't demand perfection.

pattern: Noun と Noun を兼ねて
meaning: Used to express the idea of doing two things at once or serving two purposes.
formation: Noun + と + Noun + を兼ねて
ja: お父さんは社長と経理部長を兼ねています。
romaji: Otousan wa shachou to keiri buchou o kanete imasu.
en: My father serves as both the company president and the head of accounting.

pattern: Noun といい Noun といい
meaning: Used to express 'both A and B'; 'whether it's A or B'; 'not to mention A and also B'.
formation: Noun1 + といい + Noun2 + といい + Comment
ja: 日本の食べ物といい観光地といい、すべてが素晴らしいです。
romaji: Nihon no tabemono to ii kankouchi to ii, subete ga subarashii desu.
en: Both Japanese food and tourist spots are all wonderful.

meaning: Used to specify or define one noun with another; 'the noun called', 'the noun that is' or 'a certain'.
formation: Noun1 という Noun2
ja: 宮崎駿という人は有名なアニメーション監督です。
romaji: Miyazaki Hayao to iu hito wa yuumei na animation kantoku desu.
en: The person called Hayao Miyazaki is a famous animation director.

meaning: Means 'it's approximately...' or 'it's about...'. Used to show approximation or a general assessment.
formation: Noun + というところだ
ja: 今回の試験の合格者は半数というところだろう。
romaji: Konkai no shiken no goukakusha wa hansuu to iu tokoro darou.
en: The passers in this exam would be approximately half.

meaning: Used to express 'every', 'all'. Concept of generic reference.
formation: Noun + というもの
ja: 子供というものは、毎日たくさん遊びます。
romaji: Kodomo to iu mono wa, mainichi takusan asobimasu.
en: Children, as a group, play a lot every day.

pattern: Noun といったところだ
meaning: Expresses 'at most', 'as much as', 'limited to'.
formation: Noun + といったところだ
ja: 彼の英語レベルは初級といったところだ。
romaji: Kare no eigo reberu wa shokyuu to itta tokoro da.
en: His English level is at most beginner level.

pattern: Noun といわず Noun といわず
meaning: Expresses an idea of 'both A and B' or 'be it A or B'; 'not only A but also B'.
formation: Noun1 + といわず + Noun2 + といわず + (rest of the sentence)
ja: 冬といわず夏といわず、彼はいつもアイスクリームを食べます。
romaji: Fuyu to iwazu natsu to iwazu, kare wa itsumo aisukurīmu o tabemasu.
en: Be it winter or summer, he always eats ice cream.

meaning: Expresses strong feelings about a matter; 'speaking of', 'when it comes to'.
formation: Noun + ときたら
ja: 寿司ときたら、彼は何も食べれない。
romaji: Sushi tokitara, kare wa nani mo taberenai.
en: When it comes to sushi, he can't eat anything.

pattern: Noun とは比べものにならない
meaning: To indicate something is not comparable with; 'not comparable to', 'beyond comparison'.
formation: Noun + とは比べものにならない
ja: 新しい車の速さは古い車とは比べ物にならない。
romaji: Atarashii kuruma no hayasa wa furui kuruma to wa kurabemono ni naranai.
en: The speed of the new car is not comparable to the old car.

meaning: Used to point out unbecoming behavior of a person or thing with certain status
formation: Noun + ともあろう
ja: 先生ともあろう者が、そんな間違いをするなんて。
romaji: Sensei tomoarou mono ga, sonna machigai o suru nante.
en: For someone claiming to be a teacher, it's shocking that they would make such a mistake.

meaning: 'When it comes to..', 'In case of..', signifies change.
formation: Noun + ともなると
ja: クリスマスともなると、街中がきらきらと輝いて見えます。
romaji: Kurisumasu to mo naruto, machijuu ga kirakira to kagayaite miemasu.
en: When it comes to Christmas, the whole city seems to sparkle.

meaning: Expresses the meaning of 'if it comes to', 'when', or 'once'.
formation: Noun + ともなれば
ja: 試験ともなれば、大抵の人が緊張するものです。
romaji: Shiken to mo nareba, taitei no hito ga kinchou suru mono desu.
en: When it comes to exams, most people get nervous.

meaning: Used to express 'in combination with', 'together with', 'along with'.
formation: Noun + と相まって
ja: 天気の良さと相まって、ピクニックは大成功でした。
romaji: Tenki no yosa to aimatte, pikunikku wa daiseikou deshita.
en: Thanks to the good weather, the picnic was a great success.

meaning: Expresses the idea 'without ~, there can't be ~'; 'can't do ~ without first doing ~'.
formation: Noun + なくして + Sentence ～はない
ja: 努力なくして成功はない。
romaji: Doryoku nakushite seikou wa nai.
en: There is no success without making an effort.

meaning: Expresses the necessity of something; 'cannot do without', 'not possible without'.
formation: Noun + なしでは～ない
ja: 水なしでは生きられない。
romaji: Mizu nashi de wa ikirarenai.
en: We cannot live without water.

meaning: It means 'without', 'cannot do without', 'not possible without'.
formation: Noun + なしには + Verb-negative
ja: お金なしには生活ができない。
romaji: Okane nashi niwa seikatsu ga dekinai.
en: Without money, life is not possible.

meaning: Expresses 'not to mention', 'let alone'.
formation: Noun1 + ならいざ知らず + Noun2
ja: 数学ならいざ知らず、物理なんて全然わからない。
romaji: Suugaku nara iza shirazu, butsuri nante zenzen wakaranai.
en: I don't understand physics at all, not to mention maths.

meaning: Expresses 'only', 'characteristic of'.
formation: Noun + ならでは
ja: これは日本ならではの風景ですね。
romaji: Kore wa Nihon nara dewa no fuukei desu ne.
en: This is a landscape characteristic of Japan, isn't it?

pattern: Noun なり Noun なり
meaning: Indicates several alternatives; 'either...or', 'such as...'
formation: Noun + なり + Noun + なり
ja: 映画なり、音楽なり、何か趣味はありますか。
romaji: Eiga nari, ongaku nari, nanika shumi wa arimasu ka?
en: Do you have any hobbies, like movies or music?

meaning: Indicates even a small amount or degree; 'even a little', 'at least'.
formation: Noun + なりとも
ja: 時間が限られているので、一時間なりとも練習すべきだ。
romaji: Jikan ga kagirarete iru node, ichi jikan nari tomo renshuu subeki da.
en: Since time is limited, you should practice for at least an hour.

pattern: Noun に Noun を重ねて
meaning: This expression is used to describe repeated actions or states, 'one after another' or 'pile up'.
formation: Noun に Noun を重ねて
ja: 彼女は失敗に失敗を重ねて、とうとう会社を辞めた。
romaji: Kanojo wa shippai ni shippai wo kasanete, toutou kaisha wo yameta.
en: She piled up failures upon failures and finally quit the company.

meaning: Indicates a specific situation or environment in which something happens or is the case.
formation: Noun + にあっては
ja: 戦争時にあっては、すべての人々が困難に直面していました。
romaji: Sensouji ni atte ha, subete no hito ga konnan ni chokumen shiteimashita.
en: In wartime, all people were facing difficulties.

pattern: Noun にあるまじき Noun
meaning: Expresses the idea of 'unfitting', 'unbecoming' or 'inappropriate'.
formation: Noun1 にあるまじき Noun2
ja: 彼は教師にあるまじき言動をとった。
romaji: Kare wa kyoushi ni aru majiki gendou wo totta.
en: He took actions that are unbecoming of a teacher.

meaning: Expresses the idea 'even for', 'even though', or 'in spite of'.
formation: Noun + にして
ja: 彼は医者にしてその基本的な知識がないのが信じられない。
romaji: Kare wa isha ni shite sono kihonteki na chishiki ga nai no ga shinjirarenai.
en: I can't believe that even as a doctor, he doesn't have that basic knowledge.

meaning: Expresses 'only when/after... for the first time'.
formation: Noun + にして初めて
ja: 大人にして初めて、親の苦労が分かった。
romaji: Otona ni shite hajimete, oya no kurou ga wakatta.
en: Only when I became an adult, I understood my parents' struggles for the first time.

meaning: Expresses the concept of 'even'; 'even in', 'even as', 'even to'.
formation: Noun + にすら
ja: 彼にすらその問題は解けなかった。
romaji: Kare ni sura sono mondai wa tokenakatta.
en: Even he could not solve that problem.

meaning: This expresses the idea of 'not only...but also', 'not stopping at...'
formation: Noun + にとどまらず + Noun + も
ja: このアプリは、日本語にとどまらず、他の言語もサポートしています。
romaji: Kono apuri wa, nihongo ni todomarazu, hoka no gengo mo sapooto shite imasu.
en: This app not only supports Japanese, but also other languages.

pattern: Noun にひきかえ Noun は
meaning: Represents 'in contrast to', 'as opposed to'.
formation: Noun 1 + にひきかえ + Noun 2 + は
ja: 彼の親切さにひきかえ、彼女は無感情だ。
romaji: Kare no shinsetsusa ni hikikae, kanojo wa mukanjou da.
en: In contrast to his kindness, she is emotionless.

meaning: This expresses 'Even more than; exceeding'.
formation: Noun + にもまして
ja: 私は彼にもまして、音楽を愛しています。
romaji: Watashi wa kare ni mo mashite, ongaku o aishiteimasu.
en: I love music even more than he does.

meaning: Regardless of, irrespective of.
formation: Noun + によらず
ja: 結果は勉強時間によらず変わらないでしょう。
romaji: Kekka wa benkyou jikan ni yorazu kawaranai deshou.
en: The result will not change regardless of the study time.

meaning: Meaning 'ahead of', 'before', or 'preceding in time'.
formation: Noun + に先駆けて
ja: この映画は日本に先駆けて、アメリカで公開されました。
romaji: Kono eiga wa Nippon ni saki gakete, Amerika de koukai saremashita.
en: This film was released in America ahead of Japan.

meaning: Expresses the idea of 'in accordance with', 'based on'.
formation: Noun1 + に即した + Noun2
ja: 社会のニーズに即した教育改革が必要だ。
romaji: shakai no nīzu ni sokushita kyouiku kaikaku ga hitsuyou da.
en: We need an educational reform that is in accordance with the needs of society.

meaning: The grammar point Noun に即して Verb is used to mean 'to act in accordance with', 'in line with' or 'based on'.
formation: Noun + に即して + Verb
ja: 会社のポリシーに即して行動しましょう。
romaji: Kaisha no porishi ni soku shite koudo shimashou.
en: Let's act in accordance with the company's policy.

meaning: Expresses 'according to', 'if you ask', 'in the opinion of'.
formation: Noun + に言わせれば
ja: 先生に言わせれば、毎日勉強することが重要だと言う。
romaji: Sensei ni iwasereba, mainichi benkyou suru koto ga juuyou da to iu.
en: According to the teacher, it's important to study every day.

pattern: Noun に限ったことではない
meaning: Indicates that something is not only limited to; 'not only', 'not just'.
formation: Noun + に限ったことではない
ja: この問題は日本に限ったことではない。
romaji: Kono mondai wa Nihon ni kagitta koto dewa nai.
en: This issue is not only limited to Japan.

pattern: Noun に限ったことでもない
meaning: 'Not limited to'; 'not just', 'not exclusively'.
formation: Noun + に限ったことでもない
ja: この試験が難しいのは、数学に限ったことでもない。
romaji: Kono shiken ga muzukashii no wa, suugaku ni kagitta koto demo nai.
en: The exam being difficult is not limited to just math.

meaning: Expresses the idea that 'nothing but', 'nothing is better than'.
formation: Noun + に限る
ja: こういう時には家族に話すに限る。
romaji: Kou iu toki ni wa kazoku ni hanasu ni kagiru.
en: At times like this, there's nothing better than talking to your family.

meaning: Expresses the idea of 'taking something out from something else'.
formation: Noun1 + をぬいた + Noun2
ja: このサラダはにんじんをぬいたサラダです。
romaji: Kono sarada wa ninjin o nuita sarada desu.
en: This is a salad with the carrots removed.

meaning: This is a way to express 'minus' or 'except for' some specific noun.
formation: Noun + ぬいて
ja: 私たちは、彼ぬいて全員が集まることができました。
romaji: Watashitachi wa, kare nuite zen'in ga atsumaru koto ga dekimashita.
en: We were able to gather everyone except for him.

meaning: Expresses the concept of doing something completely or thoroughly.
formation: Verb-stem + ぬく
ja: 彼は一日中本を読みぬく。
romaji: Kare wa ichinichijuu hon o yominuku.
en: He will read the book all day long.

meaning: Depends on; up to
formation: Noun + のいかんだ/Noun + のいかんでは
ja: 彼が来るのいかんで決めよう。
romaji: Kare ga kuru no ikan de kimeyou.
en: Let's decide depending on whether he comes or not.

meaning: It depends on the Noun
formation: Noun + のいかんでは
ja: 試験の結果のいかんでは、大学の入学許可を得られるかどうかが決まります。
romaji: Shiken no kekka no ikan dewa, daigaku no nyuugaku kyoka o erareru ka douka ga kimarimasu.
en: Whether you can get permission to enter university depends on the result of the exam.

pattern: Noun のいかんにかかわらず
meaning: Regardless of, irrespective of.
formation: Noun + のいかんにかかわらず
ja: 結果のいかんにかかわらず、彼は決定を後悔しなかった。
romaji: Kekka no ikan ni kakawarazu, kare wa kettei wo koukai shinakatta.
en: Regardless of the outcome, he didn't regret his decision.

pattern: Noun のいかんによっては
meaning: Depending on the matter; depending on noun
formation: Noun + のいかんによっては
ja: 天気のいかんによっては、ピクニックを延期しましょう。
romaji: Tenki no ikan ni yotte wa, pikunikku o enki shimashou.
en: Depending on the weather, we should postpone the picnic.

pattern: Noun のいかんによらず
meaning: Means 'regardless of', 'irrespective of', or 'no matter'
formation: Noun + のいかんによらず
ja: 試験の結果のいかんによらず、自分を信じ続けてください。
romaji: Shiken no kekka no ikan ni yorazu, jibun o shinji tsudzukete kudasai.
en: Regardless of the test results, keep believing in yourself.

meaning: Expresses 'like' or 'as if'; something/someone resembles much to something else
formation: Noun1 + のごとき + Noun2
ja: 彼は神のごとき存在だ。
romaji: Kare wa kami no gotoki sonzai da.
en: He is an existence like a god.

meaning: Because it is about ~, considering it's ~
formation: Noun + のことだから
ja: 彼のことだから、きっと大丈夫だと思う。
romaji: Kare no koto dakara, kitto daijoubu da to omou.
en: Because it's him, I think it will certainly be fine.

pattern: Noun の 嫌いがある
meaning: Have a dislike for a particular Noun
formation: Noun + の嫌いがある
ja: 彼は魚の嫌いがあるので、寿司を食べません。
romaji: Kare wa sakana no kirai ga aru node, sushi o tabemasen.
en: He has a dislike for fish, so he doesn't eat sushi.

meaning: Expresses the idea of 'Before doing action; on the verge of'.
formation: Noun + の手前
ja: 試験の手前、遊びに行くのは止めた方がいい
romaji: Shiken no temae, asobi ni iku no wa yameta hou ga ii.
en: Just before the exam, it's better to stop going to play.

meaning: Used to express the extreme or utmost point of something.
formation: Noun + の極み
ja: 彼の料理の極みは、誰もマネできない。
romaji: Kare no ryouri no kiwami wa, daremo mane dekinai.
en: The pinnacle of his cooking, nobody can imitate.

meaning: Expresses the highest degree of something, 'the height of', 'the extreme of'.
formation: Noun + の至り
ja: 彼の冗談には驚きの至りだ。
romaji: Kare no joudan ni wa odoroki no itari da.
en: His jokes are the height of surprise.

meaning: Used to express that it's understood why 'A' would be the case but not 'B'. It's like saying 'Well, I can understand it for A, but for B...?'
formation: Noun + はいざ知らず, Noun + だけど/しかし/とは言え
ja: 彼が遅れるのはいざ知らず、彼女まで遅刻するとは意外だ。
romaji: Kare ga okureru no wa iza shirazu, kanojo made chikoku suru towa igai da.
en: Well, I can understand him being late, but even her...? That's surprising.

pattern: Noun は おろか～すら
meaning: Expresses the meaning of 'not to mention ~, even ~'.
formation: Noun1 はおろか, Noun2 すら/さえ
ja: 彼は走るはおろか、速く歩くことすらできない。
romaji: Kare wa hashiru wa oroka, hayaku aruku koto sura dekinai.
en: He can't even walk fast, let alone run.

meaning: Even; not to mention; let alone
formation: Noun1 + はおろか + Noun2 + まで
ja: 彼は英語はおろか、日本語までペラペラなんです。
romaji: Kare wa eigo wa oroka, nihongo made perapera nan desu.
en: He is not just fluent in English, but even in Japanese.

meaning: 'Not only...but also', 'not to mention', 'to say nothing of'
formation: Noun + はおろか + Noun + も
ja: 絵を描くことはおろか、字さえ書けない。
romaji: E wo kaku koto wa oroka, ji sae kakenai.
en: He can't even write, let alone draw.

meaning: Means 'putting aside', 'aside from', 'notwithstanding'.
formation: Noun + はさておき
ja: 試験の結果はさておき、この学期はとても学ぶことが多かった。
romaji: Shiken no kekka wa sateoki, kono gakki wa totemo manabu koto ga ookatta.
en: Aside from the exam results, I learned a lot this semester.

meaning: This phrase means 'regardless of' or 'no matter how…'. It is used to express the idea that 'whatever the state or condition of the noun, we should not care'.
formation: Noun + はどうであれ
ja: 天候はどうであれ、試合は行われます。
romaji: Tenkou wa dou de are, shiai wa okonawaremasu.
en: No matter what the weather is, the match will be held.

meaning: Used to express a state in which something is entirely covered, smeared, or filled with something else.
formation: Noun + まみれ
ja: 彼は泥まみれになって帰ってきた。
romaji: Kare wa doro mamire ni natte kaette kita.
en: He returned home covered in mud.

pattern: Noun もさることながら Noun も
meaning: Meaning 'not only... but also'. Expresses that both Nouns are true or notable, but the second is particularly emphasized.
formation: Noun1 + もさることながら + Noun2 + も
ja: 彼の歌唱力もさることながら、ダンスも素晴らしい。
romaji: Kare no kashou-ryoku mo saru koto nagara, dansu mo subarashii.
en: Not only his singing ability but also his dancing is wonderful.

meaning: Used to express 'as well as', 'also', 'at the same time'.
formation: Noun + も兼ねて
ja: 散歩も兼ねて、公園に行きました。
romaji: Sanpo mo kanete, kouen ni ikimashita.
en: I went to the park, also for a walk.

meaning: Used to express that combined with something else, it caused a certain outcome
formation: Noun + も相まって
ja: 気候も相まって、この地域は農業に適しています。
romaji: Kikou mo aimatte, kono chiiki wa nougyou ni tekishiteimasu.
en: Combined with the climate, this area is suitable for agriculture.

pattern: Noun を おいて他に Verb ない
meaning: This grammar point means 'apart from ~ there's nothing else', implying the Noun is the best or most suitable choice.
formation: Noun + をおいて他に + Verb negative form
ja: この仕事を彼に任せる人をおいて他にいない。
romaji: Kono shigoto wo kare ni makaseru hito wo oite hoka ni inai.
en: Apart from him, there's no one else to entrust this job to.

meaning: Used to indicate means, methods, or time; 'with', 'by means of', 'at'.
formation: Noun + をもって
ja: 彼は誠実さをもって人々に信頼されています。
romaji: Kare wa seijitsusa wo motte hitobito ni shinrai sarete imasu.
en: He is trusted by people with his honesty.

pattern: Noun をものともせずに
meaning: Expresses the idea that 'despite something, action was carried out', simply translating to 'without being phased by something'.
formation: Noun + をものともせずに
ja: 彼女は怖さをものともせずに、暗闇の中へ進んで行った。
romaji: Kanojo wa kowasa wo mono tomo sezu ni, kurayami no naka e susunde itta.
en: Despite her fear, she went ahead into the darkness.

meaning: Despite; Notwithstanding; Regardless of
formation: Noun + をよそに
ja: 経済危機をよそに、彼は高級な車を買った。
romaji: Keizai kiki wo yoso ni, kare wa koukyuu na kuruma wo katta.
en: Despite the economic crisis, he bought a luxury car.

pattern: Noun を余儀なくされる
meaning: Expresses the idea of being forced into a certain situation, 'to be compelled', 'to be obliged'.
formation: Noun + を + 余儀なくされる
ja: 彼は経済的困難により、退学を余儀なくされた。
romaji: Kare wa keizai-teki konnan ni yori, taigaku wo yogi naku saremashita.
en: Due to financial difficulties, he was forced to drop out of school.

meaning: Use to express 'on the assumption of', 'based on'.
formation: Noun + を前提として
ja: 成功を前提として、ビジネスプランを作成しました。
romaji: Seikou wo zentei toshite, bijinesu puran wo sakusei shimashita.
en: We made a business plan on the assumption of success.

meaning: Assuming; presupposing; on the assumption of.
formation: Noun + を前提にして
ja: 好天を前提にして、明日のピクニックの計画を立てました。
romaji: Kouten wo zentei ni shite, ashita no pikunikku no keikaku wo tatemashita.
en: We planned tomorrow's picnic assuming fine weather.

meaning: Means 'as a turning point of'; 'since (time)'; 'from (time) on'
formation: Noun + を境に(して)
ja: 父の死を境にして、彼の性格が一変した。
romaji: Chichi no shi wo sakai ni shite, kare no seikaku ga ippen shita.
en: His personality changed completely since his father's death.

meaning: To take the opportunity to, taking the occasion to, on the occasion of.
formation: Noun + を機にして
ja: 引っ越しを機にして、家具を新しくしました。
romaji: Hikkoshi wo ki ni shite, kagu wo atarashiku shimashita
en: I took the opportunity of moving to get new furniture.

pattern: Noun を皮切りに / を皮切りにして
meaning: Used to indicate the starting point of some series of events or actions; 'starting with', 'beginning with'.
formation: Noun + を皮切りに / を皮切りにして
ja: 彼はその論文を皮切りにして複数の研究を開始した。
romaji: Kare wa sono ronbun wo kakikiri ni shite fukusu no kenkyu wo kaishi shita.
en: Starting with that thesis, he started multiple research projects.

meaning: Used to express 'Starting with', 'Beginning with'
formation: Noun + を皮切りに (して)
ja: 彼はその日を皮切りにして毎日ジムに通い始めました。
romaji: Kare wa sono hi wo kawakiri ni shite mainichi gym ni kayoi hajimemashita.
en: Starting from that day, he began to go to the gym every day.

meaning: 'Cannot help but do', or 'inevitable'
formation: Noun + を禁じ得ない
ja: この結果には驚きを禁じ得ない。
romaji: Kono kekka ni wa odoroki wo kinjienai.
en: I can't help but be surprised at this result.

meaning: Expresses the idea of 'through' or 'via'; going through some process or phase.
formation: Noun + を経て
ja: 彼は苦労を経て成功を手に入れた。
romaji: Kare wa kurou wo hete seikou wo te ni ireta.
en: He achieved success through hardships.

meaning: Based on; taking into account; in light of
formation: Noun + を踏まえて
ja: 過去の結果を踏まえて、新たな計画を立てました。
romaji: Kako no kekka wo fumaete, aratana keikaku wo tatemashita.
en: Based on the previous results, we have made a new plan.

meaning: Expresses the idea of 'as of', 'with' or 'from', indicating the end of something or a point of change.
formation: Noun + を限りに
ja: 今年度を限りに、この大学での教授活動を終えるつもりです。
romaji: Kotoshido wo kagiri ni, kono daigaku de no kyouju katsudou wo oeru tsumori desu.
en: I intend to end my teaching activities at this university as of this academic year.

meaning: Indicates 'like' or 'as' something or someone; 'equivalent to', 'around'.
formation: Noun + 並み
ja: 彼はプロのボクサー並みの力を持っています。
romaji: Kare wa puro no bokusa- nami no chikara o motte imasu.
en: He has power equivalent to a professional boxer.

meaning: Expresses the condition or requirement for something to be established; 'on the assumption that', 'under the condition of'.
formation: Noun + 前提で
ja: 説明できる英語力がある前提で、この仕事を引き受けてください。
romaji: Setsumei dekiru eigo-ryoku ga aru zentei de, kono shigoto o hikiuketekudasai.
en: Please accept this job on the assumption that you have English skills to explain.

meaning: As long as; for the duration; while
formation: Noun + 限りで
ja: 私が生きている限りで、あなたを支えます。
romaji: Watashi ga ikite iru kagiri de, anata wo sasaemasu.
en: As long as I'm alive, I will support you.

meaning: Expresses doing something while doing another; 'while', 'on the occasion of'.
formation: Verb-casual + がてら
ja: 散歩がてらに郵便局へ行った。
romaji: Sanpo gatera ni yuubinkyoku e itta.
en: I went to the post office while taking a walk.

meaning: Expresses 'the extent or degree of doing something is so much that...' or 'does enough to...'
formation: Verb-ます stem + こそすれ
ja: 彼は友達を助けることこそすれ、自分を卑下することはありません。
romaji: Kare wa tomodachi o tasukeru koto koso sure, jibun o hika suru koto wa arimasen.
en: He does enough to help his friends but he never belittles himself.

meaning: Expresses 'being forced to do something' or 'being made to do something'.
formation: Verb-casual(non-past)+させられる
ja: 彼に無理やり飲ませられた。
romaji: Kare ni muriyari nomasaserareta.
en: He forced me to drink against my will.

meaning: 'Cannot but', 'have no choice but to', 'forced to'
formation: Verb-dictionary form + ざるを得ない
ja: この仕事が嫌ならもう辞めざるを得ない。
romaji: Kono shigoto ga iya nara mou yamezaru o enai.
en: If you hate this job, you have no choice but to quit.

meaning: Expressing regret for not having done something; not being able to; not having the chance to.
formation: Verb-ない form (remove ない） + ずじまい
ja: 日本へ来て、一度も富士山を見ることなく帰国せずじまいだ。
romaji: Nihon e kite, ichido mo Fuji-san o miru koto naku kikoku sezu jimai da.
en: I came to Japan but ended up going home without ever getting to see Mt. Fuji.

meaning: This structure is used to mean 'Even without doing (an action), (an action) is still achievable'.
formation: Verb-negative stem + ずとも
ja: 朝ごはんを食べずとも、働くことができます。
romaji: Asagohan wo tabezu tomo, hataraku koto ga dekimasu.
en: Even without eating breakfast, I can work.

meaning: Expresses the idea of 'cannot help but...', 'cannot leave it as it is' or 'must do something'.
formation: Verb-dictionary form + ずにはおかない
ja: 彼が困っていると聞いたら、助けずにはおかない。
romaji: Kare ga komatte iru to kitta, tasukezuni wa okanai.
en: If I hear that he is in trouble, I cannot help but assist him.

meaning: 'Cannot do without', 'have to', 'unavoidable'.
formation: Verb-ないform(remove ない) + ずにはすまない
ja: この問題を解決しないと、社会全体が影響を受けるので、解決せずにはすまない。
romaji: Kono mondai o kaiketsu shinauto, shakai zentai ga eikyou o ukeru node, kaiketsu sezu niwa sumanai.
en: Since this issue will affect the entire society if not resolved, we cannot do without resolving it.

meaning: Expresses unlikelihood or that something is not likely to happen.
formation: Verb-stem + そうにない
ja: 彼はそんなに早く走るそうにない。
romaji: Kare wa sonna ni hayaku hashiru sou ni nai.
en: He doesn't seem likely to run that fast.

meaning: Expresses the negative potential; 'it doesn't seem like', 'it's not likely'.
formation: Verb-volitional form + そうもない
ja: 今日中に仕事を終えるそうもない。
romaji: Kyoujuu ni shigoto o oeru sou monai.
en: It doesn't seem like I'll finish the work today.

meaning: Expresses the notion that as soon as one action finishes, another begins.
formation: Verb-ますstem + そばから
ja: 掃除をするそばから子供たちが散らかす。
romaji: Souji wo suru soba kara kodomo-tachi ga chirakasu.
en: As soon as I clean, the kids mess it up.

meaning: Expression used to denote the idea that 'once something has occurred, it is final'; 'once', 'as soon as', 'the moment'.
formation: Verb-casual, past (た form) + が最後
ja: 彼が一度怒ったが最後、誰も彼を止めることはできません。
romaji: Kare ga ichido okotta ga saigo, dare mo kare o tomeru koto wa dekimasen.
en: Once he gets angry, no one can stop him.

pattern: Verb たことにしてください
meaning: Asking someone to pretend or accept that something has already happened or taken a certain state.
formation: Verb(past, casual) + ことにしてください
ja: 昨日のことは忘れたことにしてください。
romaji: Kinou no koto wa wasureta koto ni shite kudasai.
en: Please act as if you have forgotten about yesterday.

pattern: Verb たら Verb たで
meaning: Expresses the sequence of actions; 'after doing..., did...'.
formation: Verb(たform) + ら + Verb(たform) + で
ja: 彼と話したら、思ってたのと全然違う人だったで。
romaji: Kare to hanashitara, omotteta no to zenzen chigau hito datta de.
en: After talking to him, he was different from the person I had thought.

pattern: Verb たら きりがない
meaning: Represents an endless cycle of doing something; 'if one starts doing something, it will not stop'
formation: Verb-た form + きりがない
ja: このエンジンを修理すれば、また壊れて、また修理すれば、きりがない。
romaji: Kono enjin o shuuri sureba, mata kowarete, mata shuuri sureba, kiri ga nai.
en: If I fix this engine and then it breaks again and I fix it again, it will never end.

meaning: Expresses that once a certain action happens, a situation changes irreversibly; 'once', 'after'.
formation: Verb-た form + 最後
ja: このゲームを始めたら最後、時間の経つのを忘れてしまいます。
romaji: Kono geemu wo hajimetara saigo, jikan no tatsu no wo wasurete shimaimasu.
en: Once you start this game, you lose track of time.

meaning: Expresses a series of actions happening repeatedly one after another.
formation: Verb-stem(masu-form) + つ  + same Verb-stem(masu-form) + つ
ja: 朝から晩まで働きつ勉強つで疲れてしまった。
romaji: Asa kara ban made hataraki tsu benkyou tsu de tsukarete shimatta.
en: I'm exhausted from working and studying from morning till night.

pattern: Verb てからというもの
meaning: Expresses a change that has been consistent since a certain time or event.
formation: Verb-てform + からというもの
ja: 彼女と別れてからというもの、一人で過ごす時間が増えました。
romaji: Kanojo to wakarete kara toiu mono, hitori de sugosu jikan ga fuetamashita.
en: Since breaking up with her, the time I spend alone has increased.

meaning: Express the idea that 'only by doing something, something else can be achieved or realized.'
formation: Verb-て form + こそ
ja: 実際に使ってこそ、その価値を理解できる。
romaji: Jissai ni tsukatte koso, sono kachi wo rikai dekiru.
en: You can understand its value only by actually using it.

meaning: Expresses a repeated negative event; 'whenever', 'the more...the more'.
formation: Verb-てform + は
ja: 彼女に会うたびに、私は緊張してしまいます。
romaji: Kanojo ni au tabi ni, watashi wa kinchou shite shimaimasu.
en: Whenever I meet her, I get nervous.

meaning: Used to express a repeated pattern of action, commonly translating into English as 'every time' or 'whenever'.
formation: Verb-て form + は + Verb
ja: 私が通勤しては、電子書籍を読んでいます。
romaji: Watashi ga tsuukin shite wa, denshi shoseki o yonde imasu.
en: Whenever I commute, I read e-books.

meaning: Expresses the idea of 'even if it means....'; 'no matter what it takes'
formation: Verb-て form + までも
ja: 試験に合格するために、寝る時間を削ってまでも勉強します。
romaji: Shiken ni goukaku suru tame ni, neru jikan o kezutte mademo benkyou shimasu.
en: In order to pass the exam, I will study even if it means cutting down on sleep.

meaning: Expresses 'show by doing', 'demonstrate', 'prove by action'.
formation: Verb-te form + みせる
ja: 彼はそのパズルを解いてみせた。
romaji: Kare wa sono pazuru o toite miseta.
en: He solved the puzzle to show me.

meaning: To express the idea of 'doing something incessantly', 'can't help but do'.
formation: Verb-te form + やまない
ja: 私は母を思ってやまない。
romaji: Watashi wa haha o omotte yamanai.
en: I can't help but think about my mother.

pattern: Verb ないではおかない
meaning: Used to indicate that something definitely happens as a result or a consequence of a certain action.
formation: Verb-ない form + ではおかない
ja: 彼女は毎回遅刻をしては、先生に怒られないではおかない。
romaji: Kanojo wa maikai chikoku o shite wa, sensei ni okorarenai dewa okanai.
en: Every time she's late, she wouldn't fail to get scolded by the teacher.

pattern: Verb ないではすまない
meaning: Express a condition that 'cannot end without doing', 'must do no matter what', or 'cannot help but do'.
formation: Verb-negative form + ではすまない
ja: 失敗をしたら、謝らないではすまない。
romaji: Shippai o shitara, ayamaranai dewa sumanai.
en: If you make a mistake, you cannot end without apologizing.

meaning: Even if not completely; at least
formation: Verb-ない form + までも
ja: 全てを理解しないまでも、少なくとも基本的なことは分かればいい。
romaji: Subete wo rikai shinai made mo, sukunakutomo kihon tekina koto wa wakareba ii.
en: Even if you don't understand everything, at least as long as you understand the basics.

pattern: Verb ないものだろうか
meaning: Expressing the desire or inquisition; 'Can't I/you/we', 'Shouldn't I/you/we'.
formation: Verb-casual + ないものだろうか
ja: もっと時間があれば、ここに来るないものだろうか。
romaji: Motto jikan ga areba, koko ni kuru nai mono darou ka.
en: If I had more time, wouldn't it be possible to come here?

pattern: Verb ないものでもない
meaning: Expresses the idea that 'it's not that I don't...'; 'it's not that there aren't...'
formation: Verb-negative form (ない form) + ものでもない
ja: 旅行に行きたいと思うこともないものでもない。
romaji: Ryokou ni ikitai to omou koto mo nai mono demo nai.
en: It's not that I don't ever want to travel.

meaning: Used to modify a noun with a negative verb form; 'Noun where verb does not happen'.
formation: Verb in negative form + の + Noun
ja: 笑いのない人生は、つまらない。
romaji: Warai no nai jinsei wa, tsumaranai.
en: A life without laughter is boring.

pattern: Verb ば きり が ない
meaning: Used to indicate an absence of any limit or end, expressing 'if one starts to …, there will be no end to it'.
formation: Verb-conditional form + ば + きりがない
ja: 彼のことを考えれば考えるほど、頭が痛くなるばかりだ。
romaji: Kare no koto o kangaereba kangaeru hodo, atama ga itaku naru bakari da.
en: The more I think about him, the more my head hurts.

meaning: Meaning: 'without even doing'.
formation: Verb-dictionary form + もしないで
ja: 調べもしないで、答えを書きました。
romaji: Shirabe mo shinai de, kotae wo kakimashita.
en: I wrote the answer without even investigating.

meaning: Expresses the idea of 'not doing such things', 'no way', or strong denial.
formation: Verb-dictionary form + やしない
ja: こんな時に泣きやしない。
romaji: Konna toki ni nakiyashinai.
en: I would never cry at a time like this.

meaning: The means to do something or the way something is done.
formation: Verb-て form + よう
ja: この問題を解くように努力します。
romaji: Kono mondai wo toku you ni doryoku shimasu.
en: I will try to solve this problem.

pattern: Verb ようか Verbる まいか
meaning: Expresses hesitation or indecision between two actions; 'whether to' or 'should I or not'.
formation: Verb-volitional + か + Verb-nonpast negative + か
ja: 彼に話すべきようか話さぬべきか、本当に迷っている。
romaji: Kare ni hanasu beki you ka hanasanu beki ka, hontou ni mayotte iru.
en: I'm really unsure whether I should talk to him or not.

pattern: Verb ようが Verb るまいが
meaning: Expresses the sense of 'whether...or', 'no matter whether... or not'.
formation: Verb-volitional form + が + Verb-negative volitional form + が
ja: 彼が来ようが来るまいが、パーティーは始まります。
romaji: Kare ga koyou ga kurumai ga, paatii wa hajimarimasu.
en: Whether he comes or not, the party will start.

meaning: No way to do something. Not possible.
formation: Verb-volitional + ようがない
ja: 電車が混んでいて、動くようがない。
romaji: Densha ga konde ite, ugoku yō ga nai.
en: The train is so crowded that I can't move.

pattern: Verb ようと Verbる まいと
meaning: This structure indicates that regardless if one does verb 1 or not (verb 2), the outcome remains the same.
formation: Verb-volitional form + ようと + Verb-negative form + まいと
ja: あなたが来ようと来るまいと、パーティーは予定通りに始まります。
romaji: Anata ga koyou to kuru mai to, paatii wa yoteidouri ni hajimarimasu.
en: Whether you come or not, the party will start as scheduled.

meaning: Used to express something that cannot be done even though one wants to.
formation: Verb-volitional form + ようにも
ja: もう少し速く走ろうにも、足が痛くて無理だ。
romaji: Mou sukoshi hayaku hashirou ni mo, ashi ga itakute muri da.
en: I would like to run a little faster, but I can't because my leg hurts.

pattern: Verb ようにも Verb れない
meaning: Expresses the inability to do something even if one wants to
formation: Verb-potential + ようにも + Verb-potential negative form
ja: 彼を信じようにも信じられない証拠がある。
romaji: Kare o shinjiyou ni mo shinjirarenai shouko ga aru.
en: There is evidence that makes it impossible to believe him, even if I want to believe him.

meaning: Expresses that something is impossible to do.
formation: Verb-potential form-(removeい)+う + もない
ja: この問題を解くようもない。
romaji: Kono mondai o toku you mo nai.
en: It's impossible to solve this problem.

meaning: Expresses the idea of 'Just as...is/does'; 'while', 'as...follows'.
formation: Verb-dictionary form + がままに
ja: 窓を開けたままに、風が部屋に入ってきました。
romaji: Mado o aketa mama ni, kaze ga heya ni haitte kimashita.
en: With the window left open, the wind came into the room.

meaning: Express 'as soon as' or 'the moment when'.
formation: Verb [ます stem] + が早いか
ja: 部屋に入るが早いか、彼はテレビをつけた。
romaji: Heya ni hairu ga hayai ka, kare wa terebi o tsuketa.
en: The moment he entered the room, he turned on the TV.

meaning: Expresses preference to avoid something; 'rather than', 'if it comes to', 'if it's as...as.'
formation: Verb-dictionary form + くらいなら
ja: 一人で行くくらいなら、家にいるほうがましです。
romaji: Hitori de iku kurai nara, ie ni iru hou ga mashi desu.
en: I would rather stay at home than go alone.

pattern: Verbる こと なし に
meaning: Used to express the meaning 'without doing'.
formation: Verb-dictionary form + ことなしに
ja: 試験を勉強することなしに合格しました。
romaji: Shiken wo benkyou suru koto nashi ni goukaku shimashita.
en: I passed the exam without studying.

pattern: Verbる ことのないように
meaning: Expresses the desire to avoid or prevent a certain action; 'so as not to', 'to avoid'.
formation: Verb-る + ことのないように
ja: 車をなくすことのないように、駐車場に車をロックしましょう。
romaji: Kuruma wo nakusu koto no nai you ni, chuushajou ni kuruma wo rokku shimashou.
en: In order not to lose the car, let's lock it at the parking lot.

meaning: Used to indicate that something can go on endlessly or without limits
formation: Verb-casual + ときりがない
ja: 彼の悪口を言うときりがない。
romaji: Kare no waruguchi o iu to kiri ga nai.
en: If we start talking about his faults, there's no end.

meaning: Used to express 'without a particular intention', 'unconsciously', 'before one knows'.
formation: Verb-dictionary form + ともなく + Verb
ja: 遠くを見るともなく窓の外を眺めた。
romaji: Tooku o miru tomonaku mado no soto o nagameta.
en: I found myself gazing out the window, not really looking at anything in particular.

pattern: Verbる ともなしに Verb
meaning: This phrase is used to express doing something unintentionally or without conscious thought.
formation: Verb-dictionary + ともなしに + Verb
ja: 本を読むともなしに眠ってしまった。
romaji: Hon o yomu tomonashi ni nemutte shimatta.
en: I ended up falling asleep while reading the book without really meaning to.

meaning: Expresses the idea of 'as soon as; the moment'.
formation: Verb-dictionary form + なり
ja: 家に帰るなり、すぐに寝た。
romaji: Ie ni kaeru nari, sugu ni neta.
en: As soon as I got home, I went to bed.

pattern: Verbる にとどまらず～も
meaning: Expresses the concept of not only doing verb but also something more; 'not limited to', 'not only... but also'.
formation: Verb-dictionary form + にとどまらず + extra action or outcome
ja: 彼は仕事にとどまらず、ボランティア活動もしている。
romaji: Kare wa shigoto ni todomarazu, borantia katsudou mo shite iru.
en: He is not only working but also doing volunteer activities.

pattern: Verbる にはあたらない
meaning: Used for saying 'it is not necessary to', 'there is no need to'.
formation: Verbます-stem + にはあたらない
ja: パニックに陥るにはあたらない。
romaji: Panikku ni ochiiru niwa ataranai.
en: There is no need to panic.

meaning: The action described by the verb is deemed impossible.
formation: Verb-る + にも
ja: 明日雨が降ったとしても、傘を持つことにもできない。
romaji: Ashita ame ga futta to shite mo, kasa wo motsu koto ni mo dekinai.
en: Even if it rains tomorrow, I won't be able to bring an umbrella.

pattern: Verbる にも Verb れない
meaning: Expresses the idea of 'even if I try or want to do something, I am still unable to do it'.
formation: Verb-potential form + にも + Verb-negative form
ja: 彼を理解しようにも理解できない。
romaji: Kare wo rikai shiyou ni mo rikai dekinai.
en: Even if I try to understand him, I can't.

pattern: Verbる べからざる Noun
meaning: Used to express what should not be done; 'must not', 'should not'.
formation: Verb-dictionary form + べからざる + noun
ja: 人を裏切るべからざる行為だ。
romaji: Hito o uragiru bekara zaru koui da.
en: Betraying people is an act that should not be done.

meaning: Expresses the idea of 'must not do' or 'should not do'.
formation: Verb-ru + べからず
ja: 嘘をつくべからず。
romaji: Uso wo tsuku bekara zu.
en: One must not tell lies.

meaning: Expresses the meaning of 'in order to', 'for the purpose of'.
formation: Verb-dictionary form + るべく
ja: 成功するべく、日々努力しています。
romaji: Seikou suru beku, hibi doryoku shiteimasu.
en: In order to succeed, I am working hard every day.

meaning: Means 'it's impossible to...' or 'there's no way to...'
formation: Verb-dictionary form + べくもない
ja: その問題はとても難しく、解くべくもない。
romaji: Sono mondai wa totemo muzukashiku, toku beku mo nai.
en: That problem is so difficult, it's impossible to solve.

meaning: It's not necessary to the extent of; no need to.
formation: Verb-る + までもない
ja: そんなに心配するまでもない。
romaji: Sonna ni shinpai suru made mo nai.
en: There's no need to worry that much.

meaning: Assuming or deciding something as...
formation: Verb-dictionary form + ものとする
ja: ここでの話し合いは秘密とするものとします。
romaji: Koko de no hanashiai wa himitsu to suru mono to shimasu.
en: The discussions here are to be kept confidential.

meaning: Expresses the idea of 'as soon as', 'the moment'.
formation: Verb-dictionary form + や否や
ja: 彼女が家に帰るや否や、すぐにテレビをつけました。
romaji: Kanojo ga ie ni kaeru ya ina ya, sugu ni terebi o tsukemashita.
en: As soon as she returned home, she turned on the TV.

meaning: Expresses the result or conclusion of an action, often with a negative or unfortunate outcome.
formation: Verb-dictionary form + 始末だ
ja: 忘れてしまって、パスポートを家に置いてくる始末だった。
romaji: Wasurete shimatte, pasupooto wo ie ni okitekuru shimatsu datta.
en: I ended up leaving my passport at home because I forgot.

meaning: Tendency to do a negative action; have a habit of.
formation: Verb-dictionary form + 嫌いがある
ja: 彼女は遅刻する嫌いがある。
romaji: Kanojo wa chikoku suru kirai ga aru.
en: She has a tendency to be late.

meaning: Express uncertainty regarding duration; 'don't know when... will end'.
formation: いつまで + Verb-てform + のやら
ja: この試験勉強はいつまで続くのやら。
romaji: Kono shiken benkyou wa itsumade tsuzuku no yara.
en: I don't know when this exam study will end.

meaning: Expresses potential or ability to do something; 'can', 'able to'.
formation: Verb-ます stem + られる
ja: 彼がこの問題を解けると思いますか？
romaji: Kare ga kono mondai o tokeru to omoimasu ka?
en: Do you think he can solve this problem?

meaning: Expressing unexpected outcomes; 'just when I thought', 'but'.
formation: Sentence + かと思いきや, (Noun/ な-Adjective + だ/ い-Adjective/ Verb (past form) + かと思いきや)
ja: 明日は晴れるかと思いきや、まさかの雨が降った。
romaji: Ashita wa hareru ka to omoikiya, masaka no ame ga futta.
en: I thought it would be sunny tomorrow, but unexpectedly it rained.

meaning: Expresses the reason or cause; 'because', 'due to', 'as a result of'.
formation: Noun + がゆえに
ja: 愛情がゆえに、彼は彼女を許した。
romaji: Aijou ga yue ni, kare wa kanojo o yurushita.
en: Because of love, he forgave her.

meaning: Expresses the reason or cause for something; 'because of', 'due to'.
formation: Noun / Verb-dictionary form + がゆえの + Noun
ja: 愛がゆえの悲しみ。
romaji: Ai ga yue no kanashimi.
en: Sadness due to love.

pattern: ～から Noun に 至る まで
meaning: Expressing range from one thing to another; 'from...to', 'ranging from...to'.
formation: Noun[始点] + から + Noun[終点] + に至るまで
ja: このバンドの曲は、青年から老人に至るまで、人々に愛されています。
romaji: Kono bando no kyoku wa, seinen kara roujin ni itaru made, hitobito ni aisarete imasu.
en: The songs of this band are loved by people, ranging from young to old.

meaning: To seem like; as if; as though.
formation: Verb-て + ごとく,  Noun + の + ごとく
ja: 彼は鳥のごとく飛んでいるように見えた。
romaji: Kare wa tori no gotoku tonde iru you ni mieta.
en: He looked as though he was flying like a bird.

meaning: Used to express the reason or premise for a decision or judgement; 'since', 'because'.
formation: Verb-casual + こととて, Noun + の + こととて
ja: 彼は裁判を勝つために全資産を使うこととて、弁護士に頼んだ。
romaji: Kare wa saiban o katsu tame ni zenshisan o tsukau koto tote, bengoshi ni tanonda.
en: Since he is using all his assets to win the trial, he asked a lawyer.

meaning: Expresses the idea of 'was able to do without'; 'managed to avoid'.
formation: Verb-ず form + に + すんだ
ja: 彼は事故を起こさずにすんだ。
romaji: Kare wa jiko o okosazu ni sunda.
en: He managed to avoid having an accident.

meaning: Expresses 'regardless of whether it is or isn't'.
formation: Noun + だろうとなかろうと
ja: 試験が難しいだろうとなかろうと、全力で頑張ります。
romaji: Shiken ga muzukashii darou to nakarou to, zenryoku de ganbarimasu.
en: Regardless of whether the exam is difficult or not, I will do my best.

meaning: Expresses the speaker's intention or plan.
formation: Verb-dictionary form + つもりだ
ja: 明日は早く起きるつもりです。
romaji: Ashita wa hayaku okiru tsumori desu.
en: I plan to wake up early tomorrow.

meaning: Expresses the speaker's intention or plan; 'with the intention of', 'planning to'.
formation: Verb-dictionary form + つもりで
ja: 私は日本に住むつもりで日本語を勉強しています。
romaji: Watashi wa Nihon ni sumu tsumori de Nihongo o benkyou shiteimasu.
en: I am studying Japanese with the intention of living in Japan.

meaning: Expresses the speaker's strong feeling that just doing something is not enough or will not suffice.
formation: Verb-dictionary form + ではすまない, い-adjective + ではすまない, な-adjective + ではすまない, Noun + ではすまない
ja: ただ謝るではすまない。何か行動を取らなければならない。
romaji: Tada ayamaru dewa sumanai. Nanika koudou o toranakereba naranai.
en: Just apologizing will not suffice. Some action needs to be taken.

meaning: Expresses a special situation or event due to certain circumstances.
formation: Noun + とあって
ja: 春休みとあって、公園は子供たちでいっぱいだ。
romaji: Haruyasumi to atte, kouen wa kodomo-tachi de ippai da.
en: Because it's spring break, the park is full of children.

meaning: Express a condition; 'if', 'when', 'since'.
formation: Verb-casual + とあれば, い-Adjective + とあれば,な-Adjective + だとあれば, Noun + だとあれば
ja: 無料とあれば、誰でも利用したいと思います。
romaji: Muryou to areba, dare demo riyou shitai to omoimasu.
en: If it's free, everyone would want to use it.

meaning: Even if it is said that; Even though; Although
formation: Noun + といえども, Verb-plain form + といえども
ja: 彼が天才といえども、ミスをすることはあります。
romaji: Kare ga tensai to iedomo, misu o suru koto wa arimasu.
en: Even though he is a genius, he makes mistakes.

meaning: Express extreme exclamation; 'extremely', 'unbelievable', 'unsurpassed'.
formation: Noun + といったらありはしない, な-Adjective + といったらありはしない
ja: 彼の英語の上手さといったらありはしない。
romaji: Kare no eigo no jouzusa to ittara ari wa shinai.
en: His English is unbelievably good.

meaning: Used to emphasise that something is to the extreme; 'you have no idea how...', 'it's incredibly...'.
formation: Verb-casual + といったらありゃしない, い-Adjective + といったらありゃしない, な-Adjective + だといったらありゃしない, Noun + だといったらありゃしない
ja: その店のラーメンは美味しいといったらありゃしない。
romaji: Sono mise no ramen wa oishii to ittara arya shinai.
en: You have no idea how delicious the ramen at that shop is.

meaning: Expresses the extreme of something; 'nothing can be more ... than this'
formation: i-Adjective + といったらない, な-Adjective + だといったらない, Noun + だといったらない
ja: 今日は寒いといったらない。
romaji: Kyou wa samui to ittara nai.
en: It's extremely cold today.

meaning: Used to express that a situation is serious or extreme, often with a negative connotation.
formation: Verb-casual, い-Adjective, な-Adjective +で + ときている, Noun + だ + ときている
ja: 仕事が忙しいときているから、オフィスでは集中できない。
romaji: Shigoto ga isogashii toki te iru kara, ofisu de wa shuuchuu dekinai.
en: With how busy work is, I can't concentrate in the office.

meaning: Expresses the concept of 'despite' or 'even though'.
formation: Verb-てform + いる + ところを, Noun + の + ところを, い-Adjective + ところを, な-Adjective + な + ところを
ja: 見ているところを、急に停電になった。
romaji: Mite iru tokoro wo, kyuu ni teiden ni natta.
en: Even though I was watching, it suddenly blacked out.

meaning: Indicates a general belief or widely accepted view; often translated as 'is considered', 'is seen as', 'is said to be'.
formation: Verb-casual + とされる, い-Adjective + とされる, な-Adjective + だとされる, Noun + だとされる
ja: サッカーは世界で最も人気のあるスポーツとされています。
romaji: Sakkaa wa sekai de motto mo ninki no aru supootsu to sareteimasu.
en: Soccer is considered the most popular sport in the world.

meaning: Even if; even though; even assuming
formation: Verb-casual + としたところで, い-Adjective + としたところで,な-Adjective + だとしたところで, Noun + だとしたところで
ja: 彼が来るとしたところで、何も変わらないだろう。
romaji: Kare ga kuru to shita tokoro de, nani mo kawaranai darou.
en: Even if he comes, nothing will probably change.

meaning: Expresses 'when', 'if', 'given that' in a speculative or hypothetical sense.
formation: Verb-casual + とすると, い-Adjective + とすると,な-Adjective + だとすると, Noun + だとすると
ja: 彼が来るとすると、もうすぐここに着くはずです。
romaji: Kare ga kuru to suru to, mou sugu koko ni tsuku hazu desu.
en: If he is coming, he should arrive here soon.

meaning: Used to express 'if it were the case', 'if we assume'.
formation: Verb-casual + とすれば, い-Adjective + とすれば, な-Adjective + だとすれば, Noun + だとすれば
ja: 彼が嘘つきだとすれば、その話は信じられない。
romaji: Kare ga usotsuki da to sureba, sono hanashi wa shinjirarenai.
en: If he's a liar, then his story can't be believed.

meaning: Used to express 'when', 'if it comes to', 'in the case of'.
formation: Verb-casual + となったら, Noun + となったら
ja: 旅行に行くとなったら、荷造りをしなくてはなりません。
romaji: Ryokou ni iku to nattara, nizouri o shinakute wa narimasen.
en: If it comes to going on a trip, we have to pack.

meaning: Used to highlight a certain circumstance or condition; 'when it comes to', 'if it becomes', 'in the case of'.
formation: Verb-casual + となると, い-Adjective + となると,な-Adjective + だとなると, Noun + だとなると
ja: 試験となると、多くの学生が緊張します。
romaji: Shiken to naru to, ōku no gakusei ga kinchō shimasu.
en: When it comes to exams, many students become nervous.

meaning: Expresses the idea of 'if it comes to...; when we talk about...; in the case of...'.
formation: Verb-casual + となれば, い-Adjective + となれば,な-Adjective + だとなれば, Noun + だとなれば
ja: 彼がリーダーとなれば、プロジェクトは成功するでしょう。
romaji: Kare ga riidaa to nareba, purojekuto wa seikou suru deshou.
en: If he becomes the leader, the project will probably succeed.

meaning: Expresses something that the speaker heard; 'I've heard that', 'I was told that'.
formation: Simplified phrase + とのことだ
ja: 週末にパーティーがあるとのことだ。
romaji: Shuumatsu ni paatii ga aru to no koto da.
en: I've heard that there is a party this weekend.

meaning: Even though; although; but
formation: Noun + とはいえ, な-Adjective + だとはいえ, い-Adjective + とはいえ, Verb-casual + とはいえ
ja: 彼は頭が良いとはいえ、少し怠け者だ。
romaji: Kare wa atama ga yoi to wa ie, sukoshi namakemono da.
en: Although he is smart, he is a bit lazy.

meaning: It seems that; apparently
formation: Verb-casual + とみえて, い-Adjective + とみえて,な-Adjective + だとみえて, Noun + だとみえて
ja: 彼は運動が得意とみえて、毎日ジムに行っています。
romaji: Kare wa undou ga tokui to miete, mainichi jimu ni itteimasu.
en: He seems to be good at exercise, as he goes to the gym every day.

meaning: It is considered that; It is thought that; It is believed that
formation: Verb-casual+ とみられる, Noun + とみられる
ja: 彼の行動は無責任とみられる。
romaji: Kare no koudou wa musekinin to mirareru.
en: His behavior is considered irresponsible.

meaning: Expresses the concept of 'when one sees it as', 'viewed as', or 'considering'.
formation: Verb-casual + とみると, い-Adjective + とみると, な-Adjective + だとみると, Noun + だとみると
ja: この問題を数学の視点でとみると、解決策が見えてきます。
romaji: Kono mondai o suugaku no shiten de to miru to, kaiketsusaku ga miete kimasu.
en: When one sees this problem from a mathematical perspective, a solution begins to emerge.

meaning: Expresses 'no matter how much...', 'even if...'.
formation: どんなに + Verb-casual + うが, どんなに + い-Adjective + うが, どんなに + な-Adjective + だろうが
ja: どんなに頑張ったうが、彼の速さには追いつけない。
romaji: Donna ni ganbatta u ga, kare no hayasa ni ha oitsukenai.
en: No matter how hard I try, I can't catch up with his speed.

meaning: Indicates an action or behavior that strongly implies a certain unspoken message or feeling.
formation: Verb-volitional + と言わんばかりに, い-Adjective + と言わんばかりに, な-Adjective + だと言わんばかりに, Noun + だと言わんばかりに
ja: 彼女は優勝したと言わんばかりに笑った。
romaji: Kanojo wa yuushou shita to iwanbakari ni waratta.
en: She laughed as if to say she won.

meaning: Expresses the concept of 'as if to say'; 'almost says'; 'suggests'.
formation: Verb-plain form + と言わんばかりの Noun
ja: 田中さんは嬉しくて飛び上がると言わんばかりの笑顔を見せた。
romaji: Tanaka-san wa ureshikute tobiagaru to iwan bakari no egao wo miseta.
en: Tanaka showed a smile as if to say he was so happy he could jump for joy.

meaning: Expresses the meaning 'while', 'as', or 'since'.
formation: Noun + ながらに, な-Adjective (without 'na') + ながらに
ja: 彼は若いながらにすごく経験豊富です。
romaji: Kare wa wakai nagara ni sugoku keikenhoufu desu.
en: Even though he is young, he is very experienced.

meaning: This grammar point is used to indicate that two actions are happening simultaneously.
formation: Verb-てform + ながらの + Noun
ja: テレビを見ながらの夕食は、子供たちにとって楽しいだろう。
romaji: Terebi wo minagara no yuushoku wa, kodomotachi ni totte tanoshii darou.
en: Dinner while watching TV might be fun for the children.

meaning: Despite doing something or 'even though'.
formation: Verb-ながらも
ja: 彼は貧しいながらも、幸せな生活を送っている。
romaji: Kare wa mazushii nagaramo, shiawase na seikatsu wo okutte iru.
en: Despite being poor, he leads a happy life.

meaning: Used to express the idea that 'it's not that it's not', implying something is possible but not certain.
formation: Verb-ないform + なくはない, い-Adjective－い ＋ くはない, な-Adjective + ではなくはない, Noun + ではなくはない
ja: それを終えるのは難しくなくはない。
romaji: Sore wo oeru no wa muzukashikunaku wa nai.
en: It's not that it's impossible to finish it.

meaning: Express the possibility; 'not impossible', 'might as well'.
formation: Verb-ないform + もない, い-Adjective-removeい + くもない, な-Adjective + でもない, Noun + でもない
ja: 彼がもうすぐ戻るなら、待つなくもない。
romaji: Kare ga mou sugu modoru nara, matsu naku mo nai.
en: If he will be back soon, it wouldn't be a bad idea to wait.

meaning: This grammar point means 'if it is X, it is X in its own way', emphasizing the characteristics of X.
formation: Noun + なら(そのN)なりに/Adjective + なら(その adj.)なりに
ja: 彼はまだ初心者なら初心者なりに頑張っている。
romaji: Kare wa mada shoshinsha nara shoshinsha nari ni ganbatteiru.
en: If he is still a beginner, he is working hard in his own way as a beginner.

meaning: Not necessary; Unworthy of
formation: Verb-dictionary form + には及ばない
ja: ファーストクラスに乗るには及ばない、エコノミークラスでも十分だ。
romaji: Fāsuto kurasu ni noru ni wa oyobanai, ekonomī kurasu demo juubun da.
en: There is no need to go as far as to ride in first class, economy class is enough.

meaning: Used to express that something is unbearable or hard to stand.
formation: Verb-dictionary form + に堪えない, Noun + に堪えない
ja: この暑さはもう耐えられない。
romaji: Kono atsusa wa mou taerarenai.
en: I can't stand this heat anymore.

meaning: Signify 'cannot stand', 'can’t help but feel', 'cannot be overlooked'.
formation: Verb-dictionary form + に堪える, Verb-nai form + に堪える, い-adjective + さ + に堪える, な-Adjective + さ + に堪える, Noun + の + に堪える
ja: この暑さはもう我慢に堪えない。
romaji: Kono atsusa wa mou gaman ni taenai.
en: I can't stand this heat anymore.

meaning: To endure or withstand something; 'endure', 'withstand', 'tolerate'.
formation: Noun + に耐える
ja: 彼は厳しい修行に耐えた。
romaji: Kare wa kibishii shugyou ni taeta.
en: He endured the harsh training.

meaning: Expresses the outcome of a process or a series of events; 'reached the point', 'led to'.
formation: Verb-てform + に至った
ja: 彼は練習を重ねて、ついにプロのギタリストに至った。
romaji: Kare wa renshuu o kasanete, tsui ni puro no gitarisuto ni itatta.
en: After repeated practice, he finally became a professional guitarist.

meaning: Expresses the idea 'it is best to...' or 'nothing better than...'.
formation: Verb-てform + に越したことはない, い-Adjective + に越したことはない,な-Adjective + に越したことはない, Noun + に越したことはない
ja: 早く準備するに越したことはない。
romaji: Hayaku junbi suru ni koshita koto wa nai.
en: It is best to prepare early.

meaning: Expresses the idea that something is not difficult; 'not difficult to ~'
formation: Verb-ない form (Remove ない) + に難くない
ja: この手紙を読むのに難くない。
romaji: Kono tegami wo yomu no ni muzukunai.
en: It's not difficult to read this letter.

pattern: ～のは Noun ぐらいのものだ
meaning: Expresses the idea that 'only/exclusively Noun' or 'nothing but Noun'.
formation: Verb-casual + のは Noun + ぐらいのものだ, い-Adjective + のは Noun + ぐらいのものだ,な-Adjective + のは Noun + ぐらいのものだ, Noun + のは Noun + ぐらいのものだ
ja: この小説を読むのは楽しみぐらいのものだ。
romaji: Kono shousetsu wo yomu no wa tanoshimi gurai no mono da.
en: The only thing about reading this novel is pleasure.

meaning: Expresses regret about a situation that did not happen; 'if only', 'it would be good if'.
formation: Verb-casual, past + ば + Verb-casual, past + ものを, い-Adjective + ければ + い-Adjective + ものを, な-Adjective + であれば + な-Adjective + ものを, Noun + であれば + Noun + ものを
ja: 早く起きれば、遅刻しなかったものを。
romaji: Hayaku okireba, chikoku shinakatta mono o.
en: If only I had woken up early, I would not have been late.

meaning: Used to emphasise the objective or target of an action.
formation: Verb-volitional + びた + Noun
ja: とっつきびた友人になりたい。
romaji: Tottsukibi ta tomodachi ni naritai.
en: I want to become a lifelong friend.

meaning: Express an action that one does repeatedly or habitually.
formation: Verbs-masu-stem + びる
ja: 彼は毎日のようにジョギングに行きびる。
romaji: Kare wa mainichi no you ni jogingu ni iki biru.
en: He goes jogging almost every day.

meaning: This structure is used to indicate something 'struck with' or 'hit by' the meaning of the noun.
formation: Noun + を + ぶった, Verb +て/で + ぶった
ja: 彼は突然失業をぶった。
romaji: Kare wa totsuzen shitsugyou wo butta.
en: He was suddenly hit by unemployment.

meaning: Used to express the act of pretending or acting in a particular manner.
formation: Verb-stem + ぶって
ja: 彼はまるで知っているふうにぶって話を進めていた。
romaji: Kare wa marude shitteiru fuu ni butte hanashi o susumete ita.
en: He was talking as if he knew everything.

meaning: Express the amount of time elapsed since doing something last.
formation: Time expression + ぶり
ja: 三年ぶりに彼に会いました。
romaji: San-nen buri ni kare ni aimashita.
en: I met him for the first time in three years.

meaning: Used when someone is acting or pretending to be something they are not.
formation: Noun + ぶる
ja: 彼はあたかも知っているかのように学者ぶる。
romaji: Kare wa atakamo shitte iru ka no you ni gakusha buru.
en: He acts like a scholar as if he knows everything.

meaning: Expresses the limit or 'up to' something; 'it's only', 'as far as', 'up to'.
formation: Verb-dictionary form or ない form + までだ, い-Adjective + までだ, Noun + までだ
ja: 彼とは友達までだ、それ以上の関係ではありません。
romaji: Kare to wa tomodachi made da, sore ijou no kankei dewa arimasen.
en: With him, it's only up to friendship, there's no more relationship than that.

meaning: Expression used to dismiss or negate something's importance or significance; 'it's nothing at all', 'it does not matter'.
formation: Verb-dictionary form + もなんでもない, い-Adjective + もなんでもない,な-Adjective + なもなんでもない, Noun + もなんでもない
ja: 100万円を負けるもなんでもない。
romaji: Hyaku man en o makeru mo nandemonai.
en: Losing a million yen is nothing at all.

meaning: Assuming/Under the assumption that/In the event.
formation: Verb-casual + ものとして, い-Adjective + ものとして, な-Adjective + なものとして, Noun + のものとして
ja: 雨が降るものとして、傘を持って行きました。
romaji: Ame ga furu mono to shite, kasa wo motte ikimashita.
en: Assuming that it would rain, I brought an umbrella.

meaning: Expresses the reason or purpose for doing something; 'for the sake of', 'in order to'.
formation: Verb-ます stem + んがために, Noun + のんがために
ja: 健康を保つんがために、毎日運動をしています。
romaji: Kenkou o tamotsu n ga tame ni, mainichi undou o shite imasu.
en: I exercise daily in order to maintain my health.

meaning: Expresses the idea of 'as if to say' or 'as though' something is the case.
formation: Verb-ます stem + んばかりに, Noun + ばかりに
ja: 彼は、何も知らないんばかりに、私の質問を無視した。
romaji: Kare wa, nani mo shiranai n bakari ni, watashi no shitsumon o mushi shita.
en: He ignored my question as if he knew nothing.

meaning: Expresses the lack of a problem or obstacle; 'it's not a problem', 'it doesn't matter', 'there's no harm'.
formation: Verb-てform + も差し支えない, Noun + が差し支えない
ja: 多少遅くても差し支えないです。
romaji: Tashou osokutemo sashitsukaenai desu.
en: It's not a problem even if it's a little late.

meaning: Indicates the time when something happens; 'when', 'at the time of'.
formation: Verb-dictionary form + 折に, Noun + の折に
ja: 父が病気の折に、私は留学していました。
romaji: Chichi ga byouki no ori ni, watashi wa ryuugaku shite imashita.
en: When my father was ill, I was studying abroad.

meaning: Express extreme state; 'extremely', 'utterly', 'to the utmost'.
formation: Verb-ますstem + 極まりない, Noun + の極まりない
ja: この試験の難しさは極まりない。
romaji: Kono shiken no muzukashisa wa kiwamarinai.
en: The difficulty of this test is extreme.

meaning: Expresses the idea 'to the utmost', or 'to the extreme'.
formation: Verb-ますstem + 極まる/極まりない, い-Adjective remove い + 極まる/極まりない,な-Adjective + 極まる/極まりない, Noun + 極まる/極まりない
ja: 彼の無礼さは極まる。
romaji: Kare no bureisa wa kiwamaru.
en: His rudeness is to the extreme.

meaning: Express insufficiency or lack of something.
formation: Verb-casual, non-past + ほど/だけ + 足りない, Noun + が + 足りない
ja: 私の日本語の能力はまだまだ足りない。
romaji: Watashi no nihongo no nouryoku wa madamada tarinai.
en: My Japanese ability is still not enough.

meaning: Express that something is sufficient; 'enough', 'sufficient'.
formation: Noun + 足る
ja: この料理は4人分足る。
romaji: Kono ryouri wa yoninbun taru.
en: This dish is enough for four people.

meaning: Expresses an extreme state or condition; translated as 'to the utmost', 'extremely', 'as can be'.
formation: Verb-casual, past + 限りだ, い-Adjective + 限りだ
ja: 彼女が結婚してしまった。驚きの限りだ。
romaji: Kanojo ga kekkon shite shimatta. Odoroki no kagiri da.
en: She got married. I'm as shocked as can be.
